### QueryEntry

One query of `QueriesResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes |  | What it answers. |
| `example` | string | yes |  | Its golden example: a key on Golden A. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The grammar of its key (`-` for none). |
